d: A Rolex on the wrist can cost thousands of dollars. In France, videos circulating online appear to show luxury watches and other expensive goods scattered amid the chaos of street protests. The footage remains unverified, but luxury stores have clearly been caught in the crossfire. From Louis Vuitton and Dior to Hermès and Apple, stores have been smashed, goods stolen and storefronts boarded up. The protests are fuelled by anger over the cost of living and inequality. But when does a protest against wealth turn into an opportunity for theft? And can looting ever deliver the justice…
